notes.title: We promise this will be the last update for today!
Steam Achievements - hopefully unlocking instantly now!
notes.content: Again we apologize for being beginners. This is our first time implementing Steam achievements to a game, so please forgive us for pushing so many updates!

notes.title: October Update - Steam Achievements
notes.content:
[b]You waited for it - now we did it: We got Steam Achievements![/b]
Besides this you now have access to improved graphics and sound options.
Of course we also killed some last bugs, including the nasty bug that got some players stuck on the second page of the game.
We hope you can enjoy Hotel Tome ws without running into trouble now!

notes.title: What do you mean that's a lot of updates recently?
notes.content: Nothing really changed, just believe us.

notes.title: This is not asdf movie!
notes.content: The mysterious save slot named asdf was removed. No longer will your curiosity kill all the fun by accidentally skipping to the end of the game immediately before you even started!
